record.paper_title: Open problems in microscopic theory of large-amplitude collective motion
record.original_question: How can a microscopic theory of large-amplitude collective motion be extended to high-spin states so that it self-consistently includes the variation of intrinsic structure caused by rapid rotation, rather than remaining limited to low-spin states where those rotationally induced intrinsic changes can be neglected?

evidence.quote: Therefore, the range of its applicability is limited to low-spin states.

It remains as a future challenge to construct microscopic theory of LACM at high spin, which is capable of self-consistently taking into account variation of intrinsic structure due to rapid rotation.

artifact.status_search_result: Searches show that self-consistent microscopic LACM frameworks (SCC, ASCC, and related TDHFB-based methods) are well-developed for low-spin states, while extensions to high-spin states have been pursued only via cranking-type approximations or relativistic cranking extensions to superdeformed bands, without a fully self-consistent LACM treatment that includes rotation-induced intrinsic restructuring on equal footing with shape dynamics. No construction satisfying all the stated requirements appears in the literature; the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Self-Consistent Collective-Coordinate Method for the Large-Amplitude Nuclear Collective Motion
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational SCC method formulated for low-spin large-amplitude collective motion.
status_evidence.claim: Standard SCC LACM frameworks are formulated without self-consistent inclusion of rapid rotation.

status_evidence.title: Semiclassical theory of nuclear rotation
status_evidence.snippet: Semiclassical LACM applied to uniform rotation, providing a foundation of the self-consistent cranking model.
status_evidence.claim: Extensions toward rotation use cranking-type, not full LACM, treatments.

status_evidence.title: Towards a practical approach for self-consistent large amplitude collective motion
status_evidence.snippet: Practical self-consistent LACM scheme without high-spin extension.
status_evidence.claim: State of the art remains in the low-spin regime.
